to: Practice Administrator, DGD Clinic main office (210) 614-8612; no email address or contact form is published on dgdclinic.com, so channel none (Daniel or Todd by hand, or by phone)
subject: A link from your Wegovy and Zepbound page to our program
body:
Hello,

Several DGD Clinic providers receive our referral newsletter, so your team already knows the Bariatric Counseling Center. I read your Wegovy and Zepbound insurance page. It answers the cost questions patients ask before anything else.

My ask, in plain terms: would you add one line at the end of that page, https://www.dgdclinic.com/wegovy-zepbound, pointing patients to us? For example: "Behavioral support helps patients keep the results of weight loss medication. Learn about the Bariatric Counseling Center." The words "Bariatric Counseling Center" would link to https://www.bariatriccounselingcenter.com/weight-loss-therapy-in-san-antonio-tx/.

That page explains how our program works alongside weight loss medication patients receive from their medical providers: group and individual therapy, dietary guidance, cooking classes and movement education, in one program, onsite in San Antonio or by Zoom, and in network with most health insurance plans.

If another page on your site is a better home for it, I will follow your lead. Thank you for considering it.

Todd McCord
Bariatric Counseling Center
210.634.2200
